original_risks: Any nonempty witness except Word list today was classified as historical without an explicit inventory.
Only immediate-parent claims were inherited, so deeper generated descendants could lose source scope.
reviewed_changes: Explicit historical/current witness inventory rejects unreviewed values.
Recursive ancestry resolution preserves parent scope regardless of row ordering and rejects cycles.
Nine early-chapter historical, uncertain-cultural and radio-title exceptions have explicit source-local overrides.
Text recording locations remain provenance, not automatic dialect assignments.
remaining_validation: Final proposed rows must be checked against source evidence for source labels, registered dialects, historical citations, and uncertain-language exceptions. This code review is not source-stage installation approval.
